newsitem.title: USA: Oct Brent EFP's at $19.04-05 in late US trading.
newsitem.headline: Oct Brent EFP's at $19.04-05 in late US trading.

text.p: Cash North Sea Brent crude oil was assessed slightly higher in late U.S. trading on Tuesday, in another session dominated by exchange-for-physicals (EFP's), traders said.
A full boat of October Brent traded at $19.05 a barrel, while four partials were dealt at $19.04 and $19.05 for a total of 500 lots.
No cash deals were transacted, although traders said cash continues to command a four- to six-cent premium over paper in October.
October cash was assessed at $19.09 to $19.11 a barrel. October Brent closed at $19.07 a barrel.
One intermonth spread changed hands. September/October Brent traded at minus 10 cents a barrel, compared to an earlier deal at minus nine cents.
October/November was valued at minus nine to minus seven cents a barrel.
